# v2.30 Release Notes

This stable release rolls up dev pre-release **v2.30-dev**.

## Under the hood: code-quality cleanup

A maintenance release with **no user-facing changes**. It clears every
outstanding code-quality (ESLint) issue so the codebase lints cleanly, without
changing any behaviour.

### What changed

- **Data-loading refactor** — Report and admin pages that fetch data now share a
  small `useFetchJson` hook (or an equivalent inline pattern for multi-endpoint
  pages) that derives the loading state instead of toggling it inside an effect.
  The loading spinners, refetch-on-filter behaviour, and dashboard theatre cache
  all work exactly as before.
- **Theme & sidebar** — Reading the saved theme and sidebar-collapsed state from
  the browser now uses React's recommended `useSyncExternalStore`, so there's no
  hydration flash and no effect-time state updates.
- **Smaller tidy-ups** — a few internal-navigation links now use Next.js `<Link>`,
  the MFA QR code renders via `next/image`, an unescaped apostrophe in the help
  text was fixed, and some unused imports / redundant lint directives were
  removed.

### Notes

- No database changes, no configuration changes, no functional changes.
- Nothing to do after updating.
